purpose: Feasible neutral-standing shoulder-girdle family constrained by adult male clavicle endpoint length, neutral clavicle orientation, stature-conditioned biacromial breadth, and lateral-acromion-to-AC distance.

current_a003_for_comparison.reading: a003 shares a plausible-scale SC breadth but places AC far too lateral and uses an excessive clavicle chord.

interpretation: A normal-proportion solution family exists without changing the whole shoulder height: with bilateral SC breadth 50-70 mm, mean adult-male clavicle length/orientation gives bilateral AC breadth about 333-353 mm.
Those solutions imply lateral-acromion-to-AC offsets about 36-46 mm, all inside the observed cadaveric range 23-52 mm and mostly within roughly 1 SD of the 34±8 mm mean.
This independently narrows the likely correction: most of the a003 shoulder-width error is lateral AC/clavicle placement, not a need to lower the entire shoulder.
The family does not freeze SC breadth or scapula geometry. It provides a defensible search corridor for the later 3D landmark solve.
coordinate_convention_note: The component magnitudes are anatomical. HGPT world signs must be mapped using the established character basis (anatomical left +X, posterior direction verified separately) before writing Blender coordinates.
next_step: Combine this feasible clavicle family with the scapular local frame and glenoid/acromion geometry; then choose a single canonical shoulder target and run invariants before c001.
